scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm --dir web install && uv --directory api sync
scripts.dev:api: uv --directory api run alembic upgrade head && uv --directory api run python -m app.seed && uv --directory api run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev: pnpm run db && concurrently -n mock,api,web -c magenta,green,cyan "pnpm:dev:mock" "pnpm:dev:api" "pnpm:dev:web"
scripts.test: pnpm run db && uv --directory api run pytest
